observations.behavior: Adds a runtime eligibility check before serving cached results; cached tables are no longer used if the current HogQL query cannot be safely materialized.
observations.posthog_connection: Protects warehouse-backed queries from returning incorrect or incomplete results when query compatibility rules change after caching. This could prevent silent failures in dashboards relying on warehouse ingestion.
